title: Create: War and Economy
description: create mod but the best parts plus+ extra mods!
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/243ba5f9b242c387c0af566d5ec4760dc3cfe4f6.png) This modpack is made to elevate the create mod experience to a new level. Including various Quality of life mods, as well as mods to enhance the multiplayer experience, introducing new pvp mechanics and bring out the most for technical players

Features

- create & farmer's delight - two mods that are widely know for being mostly technical and fun to play - guns & cannons - for the people that want to commit a arson and world WW3 - more building blocks - there is now a bigger variety of block palettes and new decorum to build with - planes & jetpacks - new way to get around the map making it more fun to travel and BOMB from the sky - improved nether & end - revamping the two boimes to add more exploring to the game - more armor & gear - new ways to protect your self against enemys and players - backpacks - just another way to store loot on the go - new structures & biomes - more places to get new stuff and to - explore in new places for your new adventures - improved visuals - some shaders to make your game look fancy - new mods - new foes to fight and new things to tame and eat - money - make your own economy so you can dominant the world - dinosaurs - DINOS

Notes
